overloadMerges.note: blob is filled by the command (parameter table marks it with the '←' return arrow), so its direction should be 'out', not the syntax-position default of 'in'.

params.name: blob
params.description: Filled with the report generated from the area (in the area's current QR SET DESTINATION output type).

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Renders the report of the designated Quick Report area and places it into a BLOB (variable or field) instead of printing/writing it to a document.
